reason: A client-side composer badge that displays the provider serving the selected model and updates from the per-session ModelDirectory; the README describes no host-side actions or external communication.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页编辑器中显示当前模型服务商并随模型选择实时更新的客户端界面徽标插件。
summaries.en: A client-side UI badge for the DeepSeek Harness web composer that shows the provider serving the selected model and updates when the model changes.

capabilities: Reads the per-session ModelDirectory exposed to the composer
Displays the current model provider in the composer UI
Updates the badge when the selected model changes
